decoherence.interpretation: 9.3% error represents thermal noise and gate imperfections

ghz_state.interpretation: 80% correct GHZ states. Error pattern shows 1-bit > 2-bit structure.

scrambling.interpretation: Initial information in q[0] remains 74% detectable - information redistributed, not destroyed

reversibility.interpretation: 81% perfect reversal. 19% represents Landauer energy cost.

information_conservation.evidence: Scrambling experiment shows 74% retention of initial qubit state in correlations

present_completeness.evidence: Final measurement states encode history of operations

landauer_limit.evidence: Would require calorimetric measurement of energy dissipation

novel_findings.name: Decoherence Gradient
novel_findings.description: Information degrades proportionally to distance from source qubit in CNOT chains
novel_findings.evidence: GHZ q[2] shows more errors than q[0]

novel_findings.name: Structured Noise
novel_findings.description: Errors follow thermodynamic hierarchy, not random distribution

novel_findings.name: Entanglement Protection
novel_findings.description: Entangled qubits show lower per-qubit error than independent qubits
novel_findings.evidence: GHZ 3-qubit ~20% total error vs 3x9.3%=28% expected from independent
